newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel says deal terms intact.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel says deal terms intact.

text.p: Anglo-French Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel Plc said on Thursday the terms of the restructuring proposals it would put to shareholders were broadly unchanged.
The company said earlier lead banks had backed a final restructuring deal aimed at rescuing the debt-laden company from its financial quagmire.
Shareholders must approve the deal before it can go ahead. A combined shareholder meeting is scheduled for June 24.

The resolutions will cover a reduction in share capital to eliminate accumulated losses by cutting the nominal value of Eurotunnel Plc/SA shares to one penny and one French franc respectively and a decision to continue operating, "despite the loss of more than half of the share capital."
It will also present terms for the financial restructuring relating to the issue of new Eurotunnel units and equity related instruments.
